problem: V17 currently proves a verified terminal causal identity chain but not a calibrated fractional contribution. Reward plasticity must not trust caller-supplied numeric credit or silently reinterpret binary attribution as calibrated fractional credit.

proposed_receipt.name: CausalCreditReceiptV1
proposed_receipt.producer_authority: producer-owned causal-analysis path; consumer cannot self-assert or rewrite receipt fields
required_credit_fields: credit_score in [0,1] only for an admitted credit class
fail_closed_rules: missing or mismatched terminal identity => ABSTAIN
missing counterfactual validity/support for fractional method => ABSTAIN
binary attribution may be represented as 1 only with credit_class=BINARY_BOUND_ATTRIBUTION and must never be relabeled calibrated_fraction
fractional score must retain method/uncertainty/intervention semantics
receipt never mints truth, effect authority, confirmation or Harness authority

primary_research_basis.source: Mesnard et al., ICML 2021, Counterfactual Credit Assignment in Model-Free Reinforcement Learning
primary_research_basis.use: credit assignment measures action influence on future reward and must separate skill from luck/external factors

primary_research_basis.source: Meulemans et al., NeurIPS 2023, Counterfactual Contribution Analysis
primary_research_basis.use: counterfactual contribution asks whether reward would still occur under another action and shows spurious contribution estimates can arise under weaker conditioning

primary_research_basis.source: Meng, arXiv 2606.05263, Policy-Conditioned Counterfactual Credit for Verifiable RL of Long-Horizon Language Agents
primary_research_basis.use: language-agent credit should bind controlled interventions, validity gating, reference-policy semantics and diagnostics to verifiable outcomes

primary_research_basis.source: Li et al., arXiv 2607.16999, Counterfactual Shapley Credit Assignment
primary_research_basis.use: recent causal credit work explicitly separates policy contribution from environmental stochasticity and uses counterfactual attribution

strongest_counterhypothesis: The full fractional receipt is excessive for Frank v0.1. An explicit binary verified bound-attribution receipt may provide enough safe learning signal with materially lower compute, complexity and calibration risk; fractional credit should be added only if matched replay demonstrates incremental value.
